# Butter: a pale yellow block on a small lilac dish. Up Z.
new
material new Dish --base-color 0.6902 0.6627 0.8941 --no-slot
material new Butter --base-color 1.0000 0.9686 0.6275 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Dish --vertices 10 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0 0.03
material assign Dish
add mesh cube --name Block --size 1 --location 0 0 0.14
scale 0.32 0.2 0.16
apply --scale
material assign Butter
select all
shade flat
export butter.glb
